amendments.body: `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_baseline_scenarios.rs:798-803` hard-codes hours `0..7` as the lit window for the 8-hour photoperiod, but `crates/tank_core/src/systems/light.rs:9-13` centers the photoperiod on noon, and its own unit test at `crates/tank_core/src/systems/light.rs:21-23` shows the actual lit hours are `8..15`. As written, `do_dips_at_night_in_planted_tank` is comparing the wrong samples and currently fails on the checked-in tree. That test should derive lit/dark buckets from `is_light_on(...)` instead of assuming midnight-start lighting.
amendments.rationale: This is a concrete correctness bug in the new regression harness: the workspace is red because the test logic disagrees with the engine’s actual light schedule.

amendments.body: The maintained reproduction baseline in `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_baseline_scenarios.rs:867-939` is currently not a passing regression. On the current tree, `cargo test -p tank_harness --test e2e_baseline_scenarios` fails its `repro_day30`/`repro_day60`/`repro_day90` envelope checks and the final `reproduction_window` assertion, so the new harness was committed with stale or over-tight expectations. Either the scenario tuning or the asserted bands need to be updated before this can serve as a reliable gate.
amendments.rationale: A deterministic end-to-end baseline that already fails in CI is a real correctness gap, not just a cosmetic issue.

amendments.body: `SubstratePreset` exposes a configurable `colonizable_area_factor` in `crates/tank_data/src/presets.rs:223-233`, but that factor is never carried into serialized engine state. `crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs:733-761` reduces presets to `SubstrateKind`, and every later recomputation in `crates/tank_core/src/types/substrate.rs:11-23` and `crates/tank_core/src/types/state.rs:241-244` uses hard-coded per-kind factors instead. That means any future preset tweak or custom substrate data will be silently discarded the next time `refresh_habitat_registry()` runs, leaving the habitat registry with a second, divergent source of truth for substrate area.
amendments.rationale: This is a significant maintainability/correctness risk in the habitat model itself: the data layer advertises a configurable factor that the engine does not actually honor after refresh.

payload.summary: No working-tree diff was present, so I reviewed the current habitat-registry implementation and related harness changes end-to-end. The focused core tests (`habitat_registry`, `save_load`, `validation`) pass, but full `cargo test` is currently red in `crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_baseline_scenarios.rs`, and the substrate-area model still duplicates preset data in hard-coded `SubstrateKind` factors.
